description: NeuralTrust TrustGuard for scanning LLM inputs and outputs

collectorKey.label: Collector Key
collectorKey.description: TrustGuard collector key (tgcol_...). Optional when the API key is already bound to a collector.

apiBase.label: API Base URL
apiBase.description: TrustGuard API base URL. Defaults to https://trustguard.neuraltrust.ai

description.text: Send chat, completion, and Anthropic Messages input and output to TrustGuard POST /v1/evaluate. Block, allow, report, or redact depending on the collector policy.
Timeout in milliseconds for the TrustGuard request. Defaults to 5000.

What to do on connect errors, timeouts, and HTTP 502/504. fail_closed blocks the request (default). fail_open lets it through. Auth failures, HTTP 503 entitlements, unknown verdicts, and empty transforms always fail closed.
